# SafetyWing

> > SafetyWing provides affordable travel and health insurance specifically designed for remote workers, digital nomads, and location-independent professionals worldwide.

SafetyWing specializes in Nomad Insurance products with tiered coverage plans (Essential and Complete) serving the growing community of remote workers and digital nomads. The platform emphasizes accessibility, global coverage, and claims support tailored to the nomadic lifestyle.

## Key Topics

- Nomad Insurance
- Digital Nomads
- Remote Workers
- Travel Insurance
- Health Insurance
- Global Coverage

- Complete Plan
- Evacuation Coverage

- Remote Health
- Team Insurance
- Global Travel
